mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, rule_version_id, order_id, order_no, order_amount, order_user_id, order_user_name, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, fail_reason, next_retry_time, start_time, finish_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_bonus_calculation_task WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM dms_bonus_calculation_task WHERE status IN (0, 3) AND retry_count < max_retry_count AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW()) ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_bonus_calculation_task (tenant_id, rule_version_id, order_id, order_no, order_amount, order_user_id, order_user_name, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{ruleVersionId}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{orderAmount}, #{orderUserId}, #{orderUserName}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetryCount}, #{nextRetryTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_bonus_calculation_task SET status = 1, start_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 3)
UPDATE dms_bonus_calculation_task SET status = 2, finish_time = NOW(), fail_reason = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1

UPDATE dms_bonus_calculation_task SET status = 3, retry_count = retry_count + 1, fail_reason = #{failReason}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, finish_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
